text:
marta_pm: Quick final gate thread for Edge-Optimized GA. Need to confirm: SLA language, pricing lanes, docs quickstart, runbook thresholds, and oncall rota. Can each owner confirm deliverable + any showstopper?

devin_eng: I'll own autoscale & infra tests. Confirm SLO buckets: <=1KB and >1KB. We'll measure p50/p95 over 5m for alerts and 1h for SLA calc. Risk: tail on long-decode models; mitigation = prefix-cache + cap batch depth.

sam_fin: I'll draft pricing lanes (Reserved monthly commit, OnDemandBurst pay-as-you-go, Pilot blended) and sample invoice lines. Will propose service-credit rules tied to monthly p95 and uptime. Deliverable: pricing deck + invoice mocks in 24h.

lina_docs: Docs will ship quickstart, migration note, and an SLA blurb once wording approved. Need final API snippet and approved public SLA paragraph for inclusion. I'll open PR and tag legal.

anas_sre: Runbook/monitoring owner here. Proposed alerts: warning p95>150ms, page p95>220ms for 10m, page if error rate>1% for 5m. Runbook must include rollback: shift traffic to fallback model/region and comms template. Need metrics read access.

onthread (deploy-bot): Canary pipeline: edge-ga canary #624 passed; traffic @5% in us-west, no errors.

marta_pm: Owners recap: Autoscale/tests -> devin_eng (48h), Pricing+invoices -> sam_fin (24h), Docs+SLA snippet -> lina_docs (48h), Runbook+dashboards -> anas_sre (48h). Shiproom Fri 09:30 PT pending no blockers.

devin_eng: Granting metrics read to anas_sre now. I'll also upload autoscale policy draft to /infra/policies/edge-autoscale.md.

sam_fin: Draft SLA clause (for review): "Redwood Edge-Optimized aims to maintain p95 latency <=150ms for <=1KB payloads under normal operating conditions. Eligible customers may receive service credits per contract if targets are missed." Will add a numeric credit table in my draft.

lina_docs: I'll add that SLA blurb to the PR and include a short "What to expect at GA" section for customers. Tagging sales-eng + legal for review.

anas_sre: I'll publish dashboard widgets (p50/p95 by size bucket, error rate, GPU util, queue length) and a short runbook snippet to the handbook. Paging rota confirmed starting GA week.

marta_pm: If everyone can hit the deadlines, I'll schedule the 30m sign-off. React with :thumbsup: if good. Keep updates in-thread only.

devin_eng: :thumbsup:

sam_fin: :thumbsup:

lina_docs: :thumbsup:

anas_sre: :thumbsup:

marta_pm: Thanks — I'll consolidate PR links when they appear and post the shiproom invite.
